maria: PR <https://github.com/redwood/pr/56789|#56789> is up — switching adaptive batching to ON for L0 models by default. No API surface change, server-side scheduling only. Need runtime + infra + security sign-off before a Thu deploy window. PTAL @kevin @sarah @dan-infra
kevin: quick q — compatibility: will any client-visible behavior change? can you paste the actual config snippet here?
maria: snippet: ```yaml
adaptive_batching: true
batch_window_ms: 4
# fallback: batch_size_cutoff: 8
```
No client changes, only scheduler heuristics. pinned pools unchanged.
kevin: ok that helps. one tiny naming nit: `batch_window_ms` -> `batching_window_ms` would read clearer. not a blocker if you want to defer, but lgtm after rename.
sarah: heads up — PR touches model cache eviction and the KMS helper. please add a short KMS usage summary and the key access pattern to the PR description (who/what can call encrypt/decrypt, frequency). also add a one-line risk note. pinging @sec-eng for a quick look.
dan-infra: perf note: last time a batching tweak regressed tail latency for long sequences. can you run the L1 p95/p99 suite? I can schedule a canary slot Thu 09:00 if we have a green perf run + security + runtime ok. also add a note about private-deploy config (we need to ensure same scheduler flags propagate).

sarah: I'll take a look by EOD, can likely +1 if KMS note is clear. if anything smells off I will call it out here.
maria: thanks — updating PR with KMS summary, risk line, and batching var rename. posting results when perf completes :thumbsup:
